segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אָמַר לָהּ: ״כִּנְסִי שְׁטַר חוֹב זֶה״, אוֹ שֶׁמְּצָאַתּוּ מֵאֲחוֹרָיו, קוֹרְאָה וַהֲרֵי הוּא גִּיטָּהּ – אֵינוֹ גֵּט, עַד שֶׁיֹּאמַר לַהּ: ״הֵא גִּיטִּיךְ״.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If «he said to» his wife: «Take this promissory note,» and it was a bill of divorce, «or she found it behind him» and he did not tell her what it was but «she reads» what is written in «it and» discovers that «it is her bill of divorce, it is not» a valid «bill of divorce until he says to her: This is your bill of divorce.»

segments.he: נָתַן בְּיָדָהּ וְהִיא יְשֵׁנָה; נֵיעוֹרָה, קוֹרְאָה, וַהֲרֵי הוּא גִּיטָּהּ – אֵינוֹ גֵּט, עַד שֶׁיֹּאמַר לָהּ ״הֵא גִּיטִּיךְ״.
segments.en: If «he gave it» to her «in her hand and she» was «sleeping,» and he then «woke her, and» when «she reads» what is written in «it,» she finds that «it is her bill of divorce, it is not» a valid «bill of divorce until he says to her: This is your bill of divorce.»

moves.summary: promissory note or found behind him: invalid until he says 'here is your bill'
given to her while she slept: likewise invalid

positions.claim: a bill she did not knowingly receive as a bill of divorce is invalid until he says 'here is your bill'
